```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Opening and joining data
```{r}
select <- dplyr::select

bio <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/dea_type_prod_traite_Lea.csv",sep=";") %>% 
  mutate(type_production=as.factor(type_production)) 


ferti <-  read_delim(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/TableFinalPlante2.csv") %>%  
  select(id_parcelle,CoefN) %>% 
  group_by(id_parcelle) %>% 
  summarise_all(mean)


solagro <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/parcelle_adonis.csv",sep=";") %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID_Parcelle,IFT_H,IFT_T,p_bio) %>% 
  rename(id_parcelle=ID_Parcelle)


indicbiodiv <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/indicateurs_biodiversite.csv",sep=",")

landscape <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/landscape_var_imputed.csv",sep=",") %>% 
  select(-X,-region_biogeo)

pedoclim_pca <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/axes_pca_pedoclim.csv",sep=",") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X) %>% 
  rename(dim1_pedoclim =Dim.1,
         dim2_pedoclim =Dim.2,
         dim3_pedoclim =Dim.3,
         dim4_pedoclim =Dim.4,
         )

data_ENI <- read_delim(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Raw/data_500ENI_traits_floraux.csv") %>% 
  relocate(id_parcelle) %>% 
  select(-...1,-CoefN,-CoefK,-CoefP) %>% 
  rename(FRic_flow=FRic,FDiv_flow=FDiv,FEve_flow=FEve) %>% 
  select(-FDis,-RaoQ,-nbsp,-Soil_Sand_content,-Soil_Silt_content,-Soil_Clay_content,-Soil_Nitrogen,-Soil_CEC,-Soil_organic_carbon_content,-Soil_Ph_h2o,-Soil_Bulk_density,-xPCA_pays, -ShannonCultureTOT, -Bordure_Adj_BandeHerbeuse, -Bordure_Adj_Zone_humide, -Bordure_Adj_Prairie, -Bordure_Adj_Autres,-Bordure_Adj_HaieBois,-Bordure_Adj_BatiRoute,-Bordure_Adj_Culture) %>% 
  left_join(bio) %>% 
    left_join(ferti) %>% 
  left_join(solagro) %>% 
  left_join(indicbiodiv) %>% 
  left_join(pedoclim_pca) %>% 
  left_join(landscape) %>% 
  filter(CoefN!="NA") %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.factor(id_parcelle))
```

# 2. Select variables 
```{r}
dataset_500_ENI_2022_03_27 <- data_ENI %>% 
  select(id_parcelle,id_parc_an,annee, type_production,region_biogeo,TypeCulture,FRic_flow,FEve_flow, FDiv_flow, entomogame_1,Flow_dur,Flow_on,nectar_present_1, zygomorphe_1,forbs_100 ,perennial_100,neophytes_100 , messicole_100, nat_val_100, weeds_100,rich_sp,  shannon, JulianDay , RisqueDebordement , coord_x , coord_y , exposition2,code_parcelle,Bordure_Largeur,Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage, Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage,Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR,IFT_Herbicide2013_2019,IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019,IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019,DivRotation,SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1,CoefN, IFT_H,IFT_T,p_bio, dim1_pedoclim,dim2_pedoclim,dim3_pedoclim,dim4_pedoclim,shannon_crops,pourc_ESN,pourc_eau,pourc_routes_batis,pourc_cultures) 
```

# 3. Save complete dataset
```{r}
write.csv(dataset_500_ENI_2022_03_27, file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.1. Fusion/Processed/dataset_500_ENI_2022_03_27.csv")
```
